competitors.name: Synthetic Coffee Example
limitations: Invented contract fixture; no real advertiser or campaign was inspected.
Only synthetic card observations are included.

observations.text: Synthetic card shows a coffee cup and a preparation demonstration.

concepts.title: An easier morning
concepts.hook: Make your first cup without the morning rush.
concepts.originalProof: Film our own measured preparation steps; confirm timing before making claims.
concepts.testHypothesis: A clear preparation demonstration may increase relevant clicks.

concepts.title: Show the brew
concepts.customerProblem: The customer cannot judge an unfamiliar coffee
concepts.hook: See what goes into your next cup.
concepts.originalProof: Show our actual beans and brewing process without copied testimonials.
concepts.testHypothesis: Showing the actual process may improve qualified signups.

concepts.title: Meet the maker
concepts.customerProblem: The customer does not know who makes the product
concepts.hook: Here is why we chose these beans.
concepts.originalProof: Record our founder explaining documented sourcing details.
concepts.testHypothesis: A specific sourcing explanation may improve purchase confidence.
